terms.comment: Cato’s own verb for working the dough.

phrases.english: Knead the dough well; then let it rest.
Then knead it with your hands.

phrases.latin: Farīnam in mortārium inditō, aquae paulātim additō subigitōque pulchrē.
phrases.english: Put the flour in the mortar, add water little by little, and knead it thoroughly.

sources: Lewis & Short: depso · Lewis & Short: subigo

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
